title: The First Order
description: The world where humanity no longer dominates due to experiencing a nuclear winter. In this setting, species have mutated, and survival resources are scarce. Faced with an unpredictable future and environment, crises occur frequently. To protect themselves, humans have built barriers, but many people still live outside these fortifications, relying on hunting in the wilderness for survival.(Cgpt)

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: To reach Jingshan, travelers need Ren Xiaosu's help. While surviving the harsh wasteland, Xiaosu unexpectedly accesses a mysterious palace within his mind for the first time.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Suspecting he has awakened a supernatural power, Ren Xiaosu receives a bizarre new mission from his mind palace: he must successfully collect 100 genuine "thank-yous."

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: A dangerous wolf pack attacks, making everyone a target. Amid the chaos, a miraculous healing medicine is introduced, bringing both a ray of hope and new dangers.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The band returns in terrible shape, plunging Ren Xiaosu into a fresh crisis. When Luo Xinyu makes her first appearance, Xiaosu finds himself targeted once again.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: As the barrier authorities investigate superpowered people, Ren Xiaosu accepts the band's request to guide them. They officially depart for the dangerous Jingshan.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: The group enters the treacherous Jingshan area, facing threats at every turn. When a mysterious death occurs, everyone is left wondering who the real killer is.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Ren Xiaosu is filled with doubts as corpses vanish and warnings forbid the living from entering. He must decide whether to turn back or keep moving forward.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Utilizing master-level wilderness survival skills, Ren Xiaosu fights to escape a deadly canyon. Cornered by danger, he begins a high-stakes survival game.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: The dynamic shifts as alliances are questioned. Xu Xianchu reveals a massive secret about Jingshan, forcing the group to choose between retreating or advancing.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Ren Xiaosu faces threats within his dreams as strange events plague the group. He unlocks a new ability just as they approach a mysterious, silent city ruin.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Yang Xiaojin's true identity is exposed, and the shadow of the Tinder Company looms. Meanwhile, the previously vanished corpses suddenly reappear, raising alarms.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: A new enemy emerges among the ruined city remnants. Dangerous monsters show up, throwing the group into chaos, and Yang Xiaojin mysteriously vanishes.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: When the academy is attacked, Yan Liuyuan erupts with power to protect Sister Xiaoyu. It is revealed that teacher Zhang Jinglin is a major figure from the barrier.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: The Tinder Company's secret base is exposed as Yang Xiaojin's true goals are questioned. In a shocking twist, Luo Xinyu is revealed to be a superhuman.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Relentlessly pursued by the dangerous Qing clan, Ren Xiaosu faces mortal peril. Cornered, he decides to trigger his system by thanking himself seven times.

episodes_data.title: The First Order Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Test subjects rampage and destroy the base. Xiaosu escapes home, but Barrier 113 faces its ultimate crisis, leaving their future survival entirely uncertain.
